laws.name: Free multi-party elections
laws.description: Competitive elections with legal opposition and independent oversight.

laws.name: Restricted elections
laws.description: Elections are held, but registration, media and administrative rules favour incumbents.

laws.name: Managed elections
laws.description: Opposition is permitted but cannot realistically win.

laws.name: Single-party elections
laws.description: Only the ruling party or its approved candidates may stand.
